wv_8_ritz_cracker_area.blurb: Ritz Cracker Area is a sector of Fern Buttress on the rim of the New River Gorge, in the national park near Fayetteville. Most of its 19 routes are traditional lines, with only three bolted ones mixed in. A few easy leads in the 5.6 to 5.9 range exist, but the bulk of the climbing sits between 5.10 and 5.12, which makes it a better fit for climbers who already lead trad comfortably. The sandstone here is known for crack climbing, including a pronounced splitter that is moderate for the gorge. Expect a handful of well-spaced lines rather than a crowded wall.

wv_tomb_raider_area_climbs.blurb: Tomb Raider Area sits within Upper Rock City at Coopers Rock State Forest, east of Morgantown. It is almost entirely bouldering, 18 problems plus a single top-rope line, on gritty sandstone. The grades run the full range from VB-V0 up to a few hard V7 and V10 problems, with the bulk between V2 and V6, so strong boulderers and moderate climbers alike will find something. The headline feature is a long, steep, downhill-facing overhanging face, with a cave-like prow beside it and a few smaller blocks nearby. The holds can be fragile when wet, so pick a dry day.

wv_12_beer_wall.blurb: Beer Wall is a crag in the Bubba City zone of the New River Gorge, near Fayetteville. Its 19 routes are mainly bolted sport lines (12), with six trad climbs and one boulder problem. The grade range is wide, from around 5.4 to 5.11, and it leans easy: a good number of routes fall at 5.7 to 5.9, which is why newer gorge climbers choose it. The wall is shaded and a popular pick for a first visit, so weekends can bring a crowd. Sandstone, with a descent into the gully to reach the base.

wv_5_burning_buttress.blurb: Burning Buttress is a sector of Beauty Mountain, on the northern rim of the New River Gorge at the far end of the Endless Wall trail. Its 19 routes are a trad-heavy mix, 13 traditional and 6 bolted, and the grades start at 5.9 with nearly everything between 5.10 and 5.13. That makes it a destination for experienced leaders rather than beginners. The sector is regarded as holding an unusually dense cluster of high-quality climbs, including several crack lines and some steeper sport pitches, all on gorge sandstone.

wv_narcissus_cave.blurb: Narcissus Cave is a big, deep cave on the main side of Summersville Lake, reached along the trail past the Long Wall and Satisfaction Wall. Of its 19 routes, 17 are sport and two trad. The centre of the cave is wet and unclimbed, so the lines are on the flanks: steep 5.12 and 5.13 on the sides, with more vertical walls toward the ends that hold several 5.8 to 5.9 routes and a few 5.11s. The cave seeps, but the overhang makes it a decent option in light rain. Sandstone, more featured and closely bolted than gorge rock.

wv_7_thunder_buttress.blurb: Thunder Buttress is a sector of Beauty Mountain on the New River Gorge rim, a walk of roughly half an hour along the cliff line from the road. It holds 18 routes, split evenly between sport and trad. Grades go from 5.8 up to 5.14, but the core is 5.11 to 5.13, with 5.12 the most common, so it suits strong climbers. It tends to be quieter than much of the gorge, with exposed positions and good sandstone, and it gets sun and heat at midday.

wv_moby_boulder.blurb: Moby Boulder is a popular boulder in the Moby Area of Tilted Tree at Coopers Rock State Forest, east of Morgantown. All 18 problems are bouldering on gritty sandstone, and the grades lean easy: about half are VB to V1, with a handful of V3 and V4 problems and one hard V6. It is a good place for beginners and mid-grade boulderers, with mantles, slopers and a nice slab. The area has a lot of classic problems and is one of the busiest at Coopers, so expect company on weekends.

wv_6_thieves_area.blurb: Thieves Area is a sector of Fern Buttress along the New River Gorge, near Fayetteville. Its 18 routes are mostly trad (13) with five sport lines. Grades run from 5.9 to 5.13, with the largest cluster at 5.9 and 5.12, so there are moderate crack leads for newer trad climbers as well as hard sport projects. The routes are spread out along the cliff rather than stacked together, and the walk in takes roughly 15 to 20 minutes. It gets sun later in the day.
